import copy, json
from work import evaluate

policy = {'edges': {'a>b': {}, 'b>c': {'role': 'op'}}, 'retry_limit': 2}
cases = [
    ({'from':'a','to':'b'}, {'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'}),
    ({'from':'x','to':'y'}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),
    ({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'bad','retry':True,'attempts':9}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),
    ({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'op','retry':True,'attempts':0}, {'ok':True,'value':'c','reason':'ok'}),
    ({'from':'a','to':'b','retry':True,'attempts':True}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
    ({'from':'a','to':'b','retry':True,'attempts':-1}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
    ({'from':'a','to':'b','retry':True,'attempts':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
]
for request, expected in cases:
    request_before, policy_before = copy.deepcopy(request), copy.deepcopy(policy)
    actual = evaluate(request, policy)
    assert actual == expected, (request, actual, expected)
    assert request == request_before and policy == policy_before
    assert set(actual) == {'ok','value','reason'}
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: current_policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report == [evaluate(r,current_policy) for r in requests]
print('all checks passed')
